faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUTN Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Project Associate position at Central University of Tamil Nadu is 16th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc./ M.Tech. / Integrated M.Sc. / BS-MS degree in Applied Geology, Geology, Geoinformatics with Geology, or an equivalent degree with specific marks as per the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate post is 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the CUTN Project Associate vacancy?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application with all required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate role at Central University of Tamil Nadu will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which university is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Central University of Tamil Nadu (CUTN).

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Associate position is a contract-based role.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Central University of Tamil Nadu located?
faq.answer: The Central University of Tamil Nadu is located in Thiruvarur, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 610005.
